style: Painterly semi-realistic 3D-render look for a mobile horror game, cinematic lighting, same art style as the attached reference. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no blood, no gore, no religious statues, no monks.

shots.prompt: The same old abandoned Thai wooden sala in the dark jungle at night as the reference, same materials, roof, posts and railing, but the camera is HIGHER and looks DOWN more steeply, so the empty wooden plank floor fills the frame from about 40% of the height down to the bottom edge, and the back opening of the sala shows the misty moonlit jungle and treeline in the upper middle. REMOVE every candle, every candle holder and the ghost completely: the floor is completely empty planks, nothing standing on it. The floor is lit by a warm golden-orange glow as if many candles stood on it, the light is warmest in the middle of the floor. No people, no figures, no ghosts anywhere.

EXACTLY the same image and composition as the attached reference, every plank, post, beam and tree in the same place, same camera. Only the lighting changes: all warm candle light is gone, the whole scene is lit only by cold dark blue moonlight, much darker, thin cold fog creeps over the floor from the back opening. Still completely empty: no candles, no people, no ghost.
